features.title: Fail-loud scaffolding with actionable errors
features.description: Make init_new_package() check the return code of both `git clone` and `just init`, surface captured stderr to the user, and exit non-zero on failure. Replace the current silent discard of subprocess output with clear, human-readable messages (e.g. 'git clone failed: repository unreachable — check your network' or 'just is not installed').

features.title: End-to-end smoke test of the generated package
features.description: Add an optional `--verify` step (and an e2e test) that, after scaffolding, runs `just check` inside the new package and reports whether it passes. This proves the produced package is immediately buildable, lint-clean, and type-checked before handing control back to the user.

features.title: Richer, validated package naming
features.description: Relax the strict isalnum() rule to accept valid PEP 508 / PyPI distribution names (hyphens and underscores), normalize them to a valid import-safe module name, and reject names that collide with stdlib modules or already-taken PyPI packages. Give a precise error explaining why a name was rejected.

features.title: Configurable author/metadata seeding
features.description: On init, populate pyproject.toml author name/email, description, license, and initial repo URL from CLI flags, environment, or git config (user.name/user.email) instead of leaving template placeholders. Optionally read defaults from a per-user config file.

features.title: Preflight environment checks before cloning
features.description: Before doing any work, verify required tooling and connectivity: `git`, `just`, and `uv` are on PATH, the target directory does not already exist (refuse to overwrite), and the GitHub remote is reachable. Print a concise checklist and abort early with a specific remediation hint if any precondition fails.

features.title: Dry-run and post-init summary output
features.description: Add a `--dry-run` flag that prints exactly what would be created/renamed without touching disk, and on a real run print a short summary at the end: created path, package name, reset version, and the next commands to run (`cd <name> && just check`). Replace the current silent no-op/silent-success behavior.

features.title: Offline / vendored template mode
features.description: Bundle the template inside the published wheel (or cache the last successful clone) so `modernpackage <name>` can scaffold without ever contacting GitHub. Add a `--offline` flag, and fall back to the vendored copy automatically when the network is unavailable.

features.title: Self-update / version-pinned templating
features.description: Let the user pin which template ref to scaffold from (`--ref <tag>`), and have `modernpackage --version` also report the template/tooling versions it will produce. Add a check that warns when the installed CLI is older than the latest published release.
